carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral surface, showing a sharp transition from high-luminance on the dorsal side to low-luminance on the ventral side, creating a clear relief effect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple high-luminance, elongated white structures are projecting from the posterior margin of the visible pectoral fin, suggesting significant trailing-edge tissue trauma or macro-parasitic attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: A sharp transition is visible where the high-density, small-diameter spot patterning of the cephalic region meets the more organized, larger-diameter grid constellation of the mid-body.
